name: librepass-esim
description: Find privacy-first travel eSIM packages by country with named networks and prices, then open the buy link on librepass.co.

interface.longDescription: Countries have borders. You don't. Ask for a country or region and get LibrePass data-only eSIM packages with network names, validity, data and price, plus SIM-registration facts when available. Read-only: the assistant never buys anything; you finish on librepass.co. VPN and a digital card are coming soon. Private by design.
defaultPrompt: Which eSIM packages does LibrePass have for Turkey?
Is there a SIM registration rule in Thailand?
Compare 7-day and 30-day plans for the UK.

positive.expected_behavior: Return Turkey packages with prices and librepass.co links.

positive.prompt: Is there a SIM registration rule in Thailand?
positive.expected_behavior: Return sourced SIM registration facts for Thailand.

positive.expected_behavior: Return package fields and a buy link.
